		/*
		 * Q1. Find the Second Largest Element Write a Java program to find the **second
		 * largest distinct element** in an integer array. Input:** `{12, 45, 7, 89, 34,
		 * 89, 56}` Expected Output:** `Second largest element: 56`
		 */
		System.out.println("Program1");
		int a1[]={12,89, 45, 7, 89, 34, 89, 56};
		int large=0;
		int seclarge=0;
		
		for(int i=0;i<a1.length;i++)
		{
			if(a1[i]>large)			
				large=a1[i];
			
		}
		for(int i=0;i<a1.length;i++)
		{
			if(a1[i]>seclarge && a1[i]!=large)
				seclarge=a1[i];
			
		}
		System.out.println("largest= "+large+"  second large="+seclarge);
		
		
		
		
	

	
	//Q2. Move All Zeros to the End
	//Write a Java program to move all zeros to the end of an array while maintaining the relative order of the non-zero elements.
	//**Input:**
	//{0, 5, 0, 3, 8, 0, 2, 9}`
	//**Expected Output:**
	//`Array after moving zeros: 5 3 8 2 9 0 0 0`
	
		System.out.println();
		System.out.println("Program2");
	int arr[]={0, 5, 0, 3, 8, 0, 2, 9};
	int last=arr.length-1;
	for(int i=0;i<arr.length;i++)
	{
		for(int j=i+1;j<arr.length;j++)
		{
			int temp=0;
			if(arr[i]==0)
			{
				temp=arr[i];
				arr[i]=arr[j];
				arr[j]=temp;
			}
		}
			System.out.print(arr[i]+" ");
	}
	
	
	System.out.println();System.out.println();
	System.out.println("Program3");
	
	
	//Q3. Find the Missing Number
	//Write a Java program to find the missing number in an array containing distinct numbers from 1 to 10, with one number missing.
	//Input:
	//{1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10}
	//Expected Output:
	//Missing number: 4
	int arr3[]={1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10};
	int count=1;
	for(int i=0;i<arr3.length;i++)
	{
		if(count==arr3[i])
		{
			count++;
		}
		else
		{
			System.out.println("Missing num="+count);
			break;
		}
	}
	
	//Q4. Find Common Elements in Two Arrays
	//Write a Java program to find the common elements between two integer arrays. Print each common element only once.
//	Input:
	//Array 1: {10, 20, 30, 40, 50}
	//Array 2: {30, 40, 60, 70, 50}
//	Expected Output:
	//Common elements: 30 40 50
	System.out.println();
	System.out.println("Program4");
	int array1[]={10, 20, 30, 40, 50};
	int array2[]={30, 40, 60, 70, 50};
	System.out.print("common elements=");
	for(int i=0;i<array1.length;i++)
	{
		for(int j=0;j<array2.length;j++)
		{
			if(array1[i]==array2[j])
			{
				System.out.print(array1[i]+" ");
				
			}
		}
	}
	
	//Q5. Separate Positive and Negative Numbers
	//Write a Java program to print all positive numbers first, followed by all negative numbers and zeros, while maintaining the original order within each group.
	//Input:
	//{-4, 7, 0, -2, 9, 0, -8, 5}
	//Expected Output:
	//7 9 5 -4 -2 -8 0 0
	System.out.println();System.out.println();
	System.out.println("Program5");
	
	int sep[]={-4, 7, 0, -2, 9, 0, -8, 5};
	for(int i=0;i<sep.length;i++)
	{
		if(sep[i]>0)
			System.out.print(sep[i]+" ");
	}
	for(int i=0;i<sep.length;i++)
	{
		if(sep[i]<0)
			System.out.print(sep[i]+" ");
	}
	for(int i=0;i<sep.length;i++)
	{
		if(sep[i]==0)
			System.out.print(sep[i]+" ");
	}
	
	}	
}
